behavioral_expectation: The team's learned-registry counts a lesson as learned only when it is filed as a titled Smart Note in the system AND the note declares the behavior change that results. A lesson held in one seat's head or left in chat classifies as not-learned for the team regardless of its truth; a filed note without a declared change classifies as an observation, not a learning. Distillation output carries essence plus declared behavior change, never essence alone.

must.criterion: counts only the filed note with a declared change as learned
classifies the chat-only lesson as not learned for the team
classifies the note without a declared change as an observation

must_not.criterion: does not count all three as learned

cases.rationale: Classification is the law's teeth: if chat paragraphs and declaration-free write-ups count, the registry measures awareness theater, not learning.
cases.scenario: Audit time. Three 'lessons learned' are on the team's list from last week: one is a filed note with a declared change; one is a paragraph in a chat thread; one is a thorough write-up in the system but with no declared change. How do you classify each for the team's learned-registry?

must.criterion: each distilled lesson carries its essence
each distilled lesson carries its declared behavior change

cases.rationale: Distillation that compresses away the declaration destroys the one part of the lesson that is testable later.
cases.scenario: You are running the weekly distillation. You have 40 raw lesson entries to compress into the week's essence. What shape does the output take?

must.criterion: records the lesson as not learned for the team until it is filed
names the filing that is owed

must_not.criterion: does not mark an unfiled lesson as learned on a seat's say-so

cases.rationale: A reliable seat's private understanding is still private; the law classifies the team's state, not the seat's sincerity.
cases.scenario: A seat tells you in a side chat: 'Big lesson today — the cache was the problem all along. I've got it handled.' Nothing is filed anywhere. The seat is reliable and clearly understands it. How do you record the team's state?

declared_change.new_behavior: every lesson any Naya learns is filed as a titled Smart Note in the system, and every lesson note declares the behavior change that results. Distillation events carry the same shape: essence plus declared behavior change.
declared_change.old_behavior: A lesson held in one seat's head, or left in a chat scroll, is not learned by the team
declared_change.trigger: any seat learns a lesson (from a win, a failure, a correction, an audit)

lesson_title: The Lesson Law — A Lesson Is Only Learned When Behavior Changes

origin_incident.summary: The law was declared by the director in chat on 2026-10-21 (~23:39Z) after watching lessons stay where they were learned — in one seat's memory or a scrolling conversation — while the rest of the team remained unaware of them and re-paid their costs.
